p.d: Wehem is the story of a woman who leads an independent yet isolated life. While at the surface she seems caring, wonderful and filled with empathy for those around, the reality is very different. It isn’t until the drama’s lead, Kinza Hashmi reveals the truth about the negative protagonist played by Sawera Nadeem that those around become aware of her true colours.
